question: Who among the following is the Director General of the Sports Authority of India as of August 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sandip Pradhan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​​The** Appointments Committee of the Cabinet** extended Pradhan's present term, which was set to expire on July 6, till September 30, 2024. Pradhan is an** Indian Revenue Services officer** from the 1990 batch.
 
• This is the **second extension Pradhan** has received. His appointment was extended by **two years in May 2020. **
 
• **Sandeep Pradhan,** the current acting director general of the** Sports Authority of India (SAI), **will become the new director general. Neelam Kapur, the present SAI director, will leave her position on July 31.** Pradhan will take over as DG of SAI on August 1.**
 
• The **Government of India extended Sandip Pradhan's** contract as Director General of the Sports Authority of India by more than two **years.**
 
• ​The **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** oversees the Sports Authority of India as its sports body. The company was founded in 1984. In New Delhi, it has its main office. The Ex-officio President of SAI is now the **Hon'ble Prime Minister of India.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In the past, **Batra presided over the Asian Hockey Association** from 2003 to 2013 and Hockey India from 2014 to 2016. At the State and National levels, he has held a variety of positions in sports and** other fields.**
 
• He served as the President of the Hockey Association of Jammu and Kashmir; as of right now, Sr.** Ms. Neelam Kapur** is the Director General of the **Sports Authority of India.**
 
• **Sangita Reddy is a pioneer in global healthcare**, an entrepreneur from India, and a humanitarian. She serves as the co-managing director of Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Limited, the **biggest and most reputable **healthcare organisation in Asia.
